title: Terms of service.
intro: This page is reserved for the approved NMESIS website terms. It is a content placeholder and does not set project, purchase or licensing terms.

sections.title: Website use
sections.text: The final wording will describe use of the NMESIS portfolio, automotive project previews and interactive demonstrations.

sections.title: Project assets & permissions
sections.text: Approved terms will explain ownership and permitted use of vehicle models, imagery, films and interactive assets. Client and third-party materials will be addressed explicitly.

sections.title: Project agreements
sections.text: Production scope, deliverables, fees, review stages and usage permissions will be recorded in each project agreement. Commercial terms are not published in this preview.

sections.title: Interactive services
sections.text: Any future account-based platform or hosted service will need terms specific to its functionality. Autoverse remains in development.

sections.title: Service details
sections.text: Final service descriptions and support arrangements will be confirmed before this page is published.

sections.title: Company details
sections.text: The contracting entity, governing law and contact details will be added to the approved terms. For project enquiries, write to info@nmesis.io.
